test_gtn_equal: test two gtn graphs for structural equality including nodes arcs and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test whether two gtn graphs are structurally isomorphic regardless of node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn graph from a text file format with start and accept nodes
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn graph to a text file with arc labels and weights
test_gtn_loadsave: test saving and loading a gtn graph to and from a binary file
